② Long-handled tools, a kneeling pad, a low stool.
③ Swap jobs every 20 min, walk a minute.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Lulu spent Saturday bent over the garden beds and heaved a bag of soil into the barrow. By Monday morning, her back is stiff.

Gardening is a genuine workout. Long spells bent from the waist often leave the back stiff, so a kneeling pad, a low stool and long-handled tools help.

Hybi's garden routine: warm up with a lap of the yard and a few squats. Swap jobs every 20 minutes and stand up for a short walk. Keep bags close, bend at the hips and knees, and turn with your feet.

Pain down a leg, numbness or weakness needs prompt attention. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can assess how you move and help you stay active outdoors. Book online via the link in bio 🌱
